summary: All four files contain genuine ACL2 formal mathematical content and should remain in the primary search index. abstract-syntax-structurals.lisp defines structural operations and theorems on ASTs with deflist/defprojection, define functions with guards/measures, and defret/defruled theorems. abstract-syntax-trees.lisp defines the complete fixtype hierarchy for Remora's abstract syntax (dimensions, shapes, ispaces, types, expressions, atoms, bindings, literals, imports, declarations, files) using fty::deftagsum, fty::deflist, fty::defset, fty::defoption, fty::defprod with extensive xdoc documentation. type-checker.lisp implements the full type checker with check-dim, check-shape, check-type, check-app/check-tapp/check-iapp, check-expr, check-atom, check-bind, type inference (check/infer-app), and static environment operations, all with guards, measures, and theorems. type-checker-tests.lisp provides comprehensive test cases via assert-event macros covering all primitive operations and type inference scenarios. All files have Kestrel Institute copyright headers and are authored formalization content, not build artifacts or certification wrappers.
